Main Documentation

Welcome to the Alpha Vantage API documentation.

This is the primary content area that users are looking for.

It contains extensive documentation about our APIs.

API Overview

Our API provides access to financial market data including stocks, forex, and cryptocurrencies.

The API is designed to be simple to use while providing comprehensive data.

Authentication

All API requests require an API key for authentication.

You can obtain a free API key by registering on our website.

Rate Limits

Free tier: 5 API calls per minute, 500 calls per day

Premium tier: Higher limits available

Stock APIs

TIME_SERIES_INTRADAY

Get intraday time series data for stocks.

ParameterRequiredDescription
functionYesTIME_SERIES_INTRADAY
symbolYesStock symbol
intervalYesTime interval (1min, 5min, etc.)
apikeyYesYour API key
function=TIME_SERIES_INTRADAY&symbol=IBM&interval=5min&apikey=demo

TIME_SERIES_DAILY

Get daily time series data for stocks.

function=TIME_SERIES_DAILY&symbol=IBM&apikey=demo

TIME_SERIES_WEEKLY

Get weekly time series data for stocks.

function=TIME_SERIES_WEEKLY&symbol=IBM&apikey=demo

Forex APIs

CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_RATE

Get the realtime exchange rate for any pair of currencies.

ParameterRequiredDescription
functionYesCURRENCY_EXCHANGE_RATE
from_currencyYesThe base currency
to_currencyYesThe target currency
apikeyYesYour API key
function=CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_RATE&from_currency=USD&to_currency=EUR&apikey=demo

Python Examples

import requests

# Get stock data
url = 'https://www.alphavantage.co/query'
params = {'function': 'TIME_SERIES_DAILY', 'symbol': 'IBM', 'apikey': 'your_key'}
response = requests.get(url, params=params)
data = response.json()

# Get forex data
params = {'function': 'CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_RATE', 'from_currency': 'USD', 'to_currency': 'EUR', 'apikey': 'your_key'}
response = requests.get(url, params=params)
forex_data = response.json()
